notes: MAGMA per-gene window scan. Python preprocesses inputs once (encode chromosomes, sort SNPs by (chr_id, pos), build chr_offsets), then OpenMP across genes with binary-search + linear walk + std::erfc per gene. window_kb=10 in all benchmarks.
scaling: Linear-ish in m (chrom scan + binary search dominate) and well-amortised across genes. At biobank scale (m=10⁶ × n_genes=20K), Python takes 31 sec; native 188 ms.
